lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

Mexican authorities captured top cartel boss Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as El Chapo Isidro, in the state of Sinaloa overnight, resulting in a burst of violence that rattled civilians, The Associated Press reports.
A behind-closed-doors meeting with the top officials of Stellantis about the sale of the Brampton Assembly plant was challenging but productive, Ontario Premier Doug Ford says.
Denmark accuses Russia of plotting to kill Ukrainian American rapper on Danish soil, Fox News reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
